visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses and a black t-shirt speaks directly to the camera in an indoor setting with neutral lighting; text overlays appear identifying his 100-day weight loss plan. (2) A large snail crawls along a wooden deck railing outdoors during the day. (3) Hands decorate a cheesecake with strawberries, mangoes, and a flower candle; the scene shifts to a young girl with pigtails sitting at a dining table eating a piece of cake. (4) The man returns to the frame, eating the cake and explaining the ingredients like digestive biscuits and cream cheese while sitting in a kitchen. (5) Transition to the man in a kitchen setting, holding a large piece of braised beef, then slicing it on a wooden board; he shows the cross-section to the camera and adds eggs and dried tofu from a container. (6) He microwaves the food and prepares a plate with chopped green onions and white pepper. (7) The man sits at a table, eating the beef with chopsticks and gesturing with his hands while describing the flavor. (8) Outdoor nighttime scene: the man sits on a wooden deck putting on his shoes, interacting with a black and white spotted dog; he then performs squats, push-ups, and planks on a blue mat, followed by kettlebell swings. (9) He shows his smartwatch displaying 393 calories burned. (10) Back in the kitchen, the man holds bags of vegetables and a piece of sea bass; he chops onions, tomatoes, and mushrooms, then sautés them in a pan with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. (11) He adds water and the fish, covers the pan, and later finishes the dish with lemon juice and basil leaves. (12) He eats the Mediterranean-style stewed fish at a wooden table, showing close-ups of the fish meat and vegetables. (13) An animated outro features two characters on a yellow background.
